newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Oct yr/yr CPI up 2.6 pct (EU method).
newsitem.headline: Danish Oct yr/yr CPI up 2.6 pct (EU method).

text.p: Danish consumer prices rose 0.2 per cent in October from September and were 2.6 percent higher than in October 1995, the National Statistics Office said on Thursday.

The CPI data was issued under new EU-harmonised calculation methods. Under the traditional Danish national formula the respective figures would have risen 0.1 percent month-on-month and 2.4 percent year-on-year.
NEW EU FORMULA Oct 1996 Sept 1996 Oct 1995
NOTE - Average analyst expectations were for a 2.4 percent rise from October 1995 according to the national formula. -- Steve Weizman, Copenhagen Newsroom +45-33-969650
